section:
## Presto arithmetic, admission and train-only temporal evidence (2026-10-23)

[All-substrate arithmetic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1057_codex_digestion-arithmetic/README.md), [canonical admission and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1123_codex_digestion-timecourse-admission/README.md), and [training-only temporal repeatability](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1138_codex_digestion-temporal-signal/README.md) are published on the Presto draft PR.

All17 original arithmetic conditions pass (545,664 raw quantities/280,664 final slots). Source mock time-zero rows occur in CaM, IF2, UBE2S and RF1; real-baseline evidence and the RF1 time exclusion remain necessary. The recipe admits30,566 curves/125,423 positive targets, independently replayed across all50,372 disposition groups. There are only6/3/2 admitted train/validation/test parents. Reviewed source upgrades retain all numerical targets/mappings/splits; the later zero-count check adds a reason to one already-excluded curve only. Original and reviewed exports, source hashes, failed compatibility attempt and exact metadata amendment are preserved.

A separately preregistered training-only temporal-ratio diagnostic passes its descriptive gate in5/6 parents: equal-parent log10 RMSE0.67267 using the other biological label versus0.98579 for no temporal change. LEDGF worsens and remains included. All67,576 diagnostic predictions and independent scalar replay are retained. This is supplied-measurement repeatability, not a sequence model or concentration prediction. No biological kinetic fit has run.

Immutable Hitlist3e0b999 passes the unchanged normal guarded suite:3,350tests/10warnings/176.08s with two workers. This does not cover subsequent upstream edits or replace final-head release gates. Upstream review independently inspected held-out descriptive repeatability; preserve this exposure in later modeling claims. No kinetic model outcomes or split changes have been used. [Next sequence-to-rate and exact/sampled specification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/agents/codex/plans/biological-independent-cut-fit.md). Full APC machinery/transport/clearance/MS calibration requirements remain open.

## Bounded temporal admission and signal now verified (2026-10-23)

Source PR773 is merged; recipe/release work is tracked by775. Presto has published [all17-condition arithmetic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1057_codex_digestion-arithmetic/README.md), [full canonical admission/replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1123_codex_digestion-timecourse-admission/README.md) and [training-only temporal repeatability](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1138_codex_digestion-temporal-signal/README.md). The earlier body sections are historical snapshots. All545,664 raw quantities/280,664 final slots replay, but four conditions use mock baseline rows. Admission retains30,566curves/125,423positive measurements with6/3/2 admitted train/val/test parents and original exclusions. Other-label temporal prediction beats no change in5/6 training parents (equal-parent log10 RMSE0.673 vs0.986); LEDGF remains a negative result. Independent replay verifies every source/target/group decision and all67,576 diagnostic predictions. Reviewed source/zero-count changes preserve admitted targets byte-for-byte. No biological kinetic fit, calibrated MS-response or APC concentration model is established. Upstream held-out descriptive repeatability exposure is documented; no model test outcomes or resplit have been used.775 retains final-head software/release acceptance; full availability goal remains open.

## Digestion admission and temporal signal checkpoint (2026-10-23)

Commit1d585b9 adds three registered reports: all17-condition original arithmetic, canonical contiguous time-course admission, and training-only temporal repeatability. Source arithmetic matches545,664 raw quantities/280,664 final slots; four conditions reveal inserted time-zero baselines. The recipe preserves every disposition and admits30,566curves/125,423positive targets across6/3/2 train/val/test parents. Independent full target/group replay and reviewed-source conservation pass. Other-biological-label temporal responses beat no change in5/6 training parents (equal-parent log10 RMSE0.673 vs0.986); LEDGF stays included. Every67,576 diagnostic prediction is retained and independently checked. These results support the next bounded sequence-to-cut-rate fit but are not model generalization or concentration validation. Upstream descriptive held-out repeatability exposure is explicitly recorded. Frozen Hitlist3e0b999 passes3,350 normal guarded tests; newer upstream edits retain separate release gates. Exact launch/source bundles, raw exports, plots, failures/amendments and the next model specification are included. This PR remains draft and the biological availability goal remains active.
